title: Q-FLEETMAP-ops: ultrastable/ops is not equal to its source (could not be read)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe ops
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** open

ultrastable/ops is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): could not be read.

- the repository could not be read: no clone beside this checkout and no public tree (private, missing or refused)

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe ops
